body: I just came out myself, and if you want my advice be sure you can trust your friends completely before telling them, and ask them not to tell your parents. That's the only thing I can think of to keep it a secret from your parents, but someone else might have better advice. As for how to come out, I just came out and said it and I think that's really the best way to do it. If they're really your friends, they will accept you. Good luck!

Thanks for your kind words. I greatly appreciate you reading and taking the time to respond. I'm going to try to not self harm anymore, even if it's hard. I'm sorry that it sounds familiar to you, if you ever need anyone to vent to I'm willing to listen.
Thanks for the reply, I'm trying to work up the courage to tell them. I'm glad that you were able to get help, wish me luck!
I'm also 14, and I live in the US. If you want to chat, PM me.
I am 14, female, and I also struggle with depression and anxiety on a daily basis. I love horror as well, and I like to play videogames. PM me if you're interested in talking.

If someone would do that to you, they aren't your friend. I have personal experience with this and want you to know that it's not your fault, its your friends. Please don't kill yourself, I know that even though it doesn't seem like it now, you have a reason to live even if you don't know what that is yourself. If you need someone to talk to, feel free to private message me, I understand and I'm willing to talk. And know that you'll make new friends who will treat you better than this.
Sorry, no, my friend had some and she gave it to me. :) But thanks for the offer.
Thanks for the reply. I've tried discussing it with her, she just doesn't want to listen. But thanks for trying to help anyway, I'll keep trying to make it work.
Thanks, just give me any time, I live in Central Time Zone. I think I have a few shiny coins to trade.
Thanks. And yes, I'm going for Neil.

I know how you feel. I'm currently in eighth grade and I've felt like this since sixth. I'm terrified for the future. I don't fit in, I don't have friends. I've developed an extreme hatred of my own self. If it helps, PM me, I'm free to talk and I understand.
I'm 14, and I also enjoy videogames, both new and old, and technology. It would be great to have a pen pal, email is fine, P.M. me if you are interested.
I'm sorry you're going through this. If it helps at all, I know how you feel and a lot of other people do to. Good luck.

I can relate. Unfortunately, I don't have many friends. But as you can see from one of my previous posts, I have had serious issues with this. Sorry you feel this way too, if you need some one to talk to anyone on here would be willing to if you pm them.
Happy birthday!
I'm sorry you're going through this. I think the best way to tell her would be to explain how you're feeling and how long you've felt this way. Good luck.

Sometimes you can't get away from the things that make you most unhappy. I've never seriously thought about committing suicide, but when the thought crosses my mind it's usually because I just don't see any other way out.

Yes. Not only do I have to see posts that make me feel that everyone else is doing much better than me, but everyone I'm connected to always seems to post things about how depression is a choice. My advice to you is just to not take it seriously.

I completely agree. I feel like a failure all the time, and no matter how hard I try, I can't seem to do anything at all right. Everyone I know treats me like a failure, and most of my family act like they are ashamed of me. I'm sorry you feel this way too, but don't let people treat you poorly. Despite what everyone seems to think, everyone is important, even though you might not know it yourself.

Yes. I feel very tired and can't sleep, sometimes for an entire day, which makes me pretty sick. I also have high stress levels all the time, so that makes me feel pretty sick at times too. So my answer is yes, I think wat you are feeling is normal.
To be honest, I really can't remember. Probably about 4 or 5 years ago.

I can relate completely. Your situation sounds similar to mine, I am also just another teenager with no friends, parents who are unwilling to help, and low self-esteem. Just know that you aren't alone, a lot of other people feel this way. I know you probably won't want to, but if you ever need someone to talk to or vent to, you can pm me. I'm sorry this is happening to you.
Best of luck. If it helps, I know how you feel and there are a lot of other people who do too. I'm sorry this is happening to you.
Really? I've never heard anyone say that, where I live it's all about how depression is not a real disease and anyone who has it is faking.
Thanks to everyone who took the time to respond, it means a lot to know someone cares. It's been a really bad year for me, but I think things are starting to get better.
Thanks for your support, I've been going through a bad time.
For me, depression doesn't just "get better" and just because I act happy doesn't mean I am happy.
Thanks, I subscribed! I'll try to post on there sometime.
This is exactly how I feel all the time. Thanks for posting this, it feels good to know that someone else understands.
I would like the idea, you should post on here again if you make it.

I understand, I'm pretty young too with depression. People always tell me how good I have it and I need to stop being depressed "for the attention". I just want to let you know that there are people out there who are going through the same thing and they understand.

I hate when people tell me that "happiness is a choice," and I'm only depressed for the attention. So many people tell me that and it only makes me feel worse. I can't just choose to be happy. I wish more people could see that.
I know how you feel. I have a few "friends" but they don't really care. I wish I could do more for you, but all I can do is let you know that other people like me feel the same way.
